meta.source: kt-cre-design-system skill (brand.json v1.0.0 with the 2026-09-10 Powder Blue override) and kyletran.dev production CSS, read 2026-09-17; kt-corporate-memo skill (memo.css, house-style) remapped to Powder Blue, 2026-09-17

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card, table and document ground. In a dark host (Claude desktop, chat widgets) leave the page transparent and let the host show through; #161616 is the stand-in for previews.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page field behind cards on kyletran.dev and dashboards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Zebra rows, inset panels, editor rows.

tokens.name: surface-fill
tokens.usage: Total rows, ghost-button hover, tag fill, active nav item.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Header band, hero field and spotlight card on kyletran.dev. Text on it is `on-band`.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on `band` (17.4:1 light, 16.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface`, `surface-page` and `surface-raised` (14.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Sub-labels and secondary button text on `surface` and `surface-fill` (9.2:1 light, 10.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and disabled text on `surface`, `surface-page` and `surface-fill` (5.7:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase labels, source lines and captions on `surface`, `surface-page` and `surface-fill` (4.5:1 light, 4.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button type. Decorative only; disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline: card borders, cell borders, the rule after a section heading.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and continuation-page rules. Kept from the source at 1.5:1, below the 3:1 non-text floor; pair every control with a visible label and the `focus` ring.

tokens.name: rule-divider
tokens.usage: 2px divider above total rows and between major blocks.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Kytex Powder Blue. Filled areas only on light surfaces (primary button, selected segment, section-break field), always with `on-accent` type. On dark surfaces also strokes, rules and text (11.3:1). Budget about 5% of a view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. `on-accent` type holds 8.0:1 light, 11.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-row tint and light chart fills.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Input cells, Excel hand-entry cells, callout fills, row hover.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and links on `surface` and `accent-wash` (5.8:1 and 5.2:1 light; 11.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Thin accent strokes on white: active tab underline, section square, KPI top rule, nav top rule (3.1:1 on `surface`; on `surface-page` it is 2.98:1, so keep these marks on `surface`). In memos it also draws the 3pt letterhead rule, the BLUF and decision-block rules, and the bar-chart fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Type on any `accent` or `accent-hover` fill (9.7:1). Never white.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. Chosen above `accent-line` on light because it must clear 3:1 on `surface-page` too (5.5:1); 11.3:1 on dark.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Status squares, 2px top rules and positive deltas on `surface` (5.4:1 light, 8.5:1 dark). Never a fill behind body copy.

tokens.name: positive-text
tokens.usage: Positive badge text on `positive-bg` (5.9:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: positive-bg
tokens.usage: Positive badge and notice fill.

tokens.name: positive-border
tokens.usage: Positive badge border.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Caution squares and 2px rules (4.4:1 on `surface` light, kept from the source; below 4.5:1, so caution text and deltas use `caution-text`). 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: caution-text
tokens.usage: Caution badge text on `caution-bg` (6.4:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: caution-bg
tokens.usage: Caution badge and notice fill.

tokens.name: caution-border
tokens.usage: Caution badge border.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative figures, error text and danger button fill on `surface` (7.1:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: negative-hover
tokens.usage: Danger button hover.

tokens.name: on-negative
tokens.usage: Type on a `negative` fill (7.1:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: negative-text
tokens.usage: Negative badge text on `negative-bg` (6.6:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: negative-bg
tokens.usage: Negative badge and notice fill.

tokens.name: negative-border
tokens.usage: Negative badge border.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Table header row. Light: ink band with `table-head-text`. Dark: a plain row with a 2px `accent` rule beneath.

tokens.name: table-head-text
tokens.usage: Uppercase header labels on `table-head` (15.5:1 light, 4.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: table-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Lead chart series.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Second series. Navy, separated from the accent by lightness; dark theme lifts it so it reads on #161616.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Third series (sand).

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series (slate).

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series (sage).

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Other, always last. Forecast and projected series also drop to this grey.

families.sans: "Open Sans", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: Consolas, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Inconsolata, "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero name on `band`. One per page.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Page section titles on kyletran.dev (Selected Work, Experience).

styles.name: section-title-sm
styles.usage: Section titles below 768px and on dense pages.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big number on a cover or KPI hero.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles inside tools and reports.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card and block headings.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Underwriting and market work from coursework and internships.
styles.usage: Long-form body on kyletran.dev and case studies.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Occupancy held at 96.4% through the quarter.
styles.usage: Interface body copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells and dense copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Notes and source lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, field labels and column labels. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a featured card on kyletran.dev.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Uppercase site navigation items.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Uppercase button labels, verb first, two words at most.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Print floor. Nothing smaller.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Table figures, IDs, cell references, file names. Tabular numerals, right-aligned.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Raw system values inside KPI blocks.

styles.name: memo-title
styles.sample: Mesa Ridge Industrial Park: repositioning capital request
styles.usage: Memo title, 15pt.

styles.name: memo-section
styles.sample: 01  Occupancy and rent drive the return
styles.usage: Numbered section head over a hairline, 11pt.

styles.name: memo-bluf
styles.sample: Approve $2,450,000 to reposition Mesa Ridge Industrial Park.
styles.usage: Bottom line paragraph, 11pt.

styles.name: memo-body
styles.usage: Memo body, 10pt, full measure.

styles.name: memo-small
styles.usage: Table body, meta values and the ask, 9.5pt.

styles.name: memo-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, table headers and footer, 8.5pt. The print floor for labels and figures.

styles.name: memo-figure
styles.usage: Schedule figures and source ranges, 8.5pt mono. Figures never go below this size.

styles.name: memo-tile
styles.usage: KPI tile value, 13.5pt mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, delta offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to value, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Section heading gap, stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Cell padding, KPI top padding, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding (large), header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header horizontal padding, featured card body padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The mark, print rules, and every button and card on kyletran.dev (the portfolio is square).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Tags and checkboxes in tools.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs in tools and dashboards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and bordered tables in tools and dashboards.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Resting card in tools (Fluent depth 2). Dropped on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered card (depth 8). Never stack with a heavy border.

tokens.name: shadow-shell
tokens.usage: Page shell (depth 16).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Project and credential cards on kyletran.dev.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered project card on kyletran.dev, paired with a 4px lift.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: `rule` borders.

tokens.name: stroke-divider
tokens.usage: `rule-divider` above totals; KPI top rule; active tab underline.

tokens.name: stroke-accent
tokens.usage: Accent rule under a page header or site nav, page one only.
